context: Representative implementation cleanup from the issue: add behavior while replacing AI-written isPresent/get upsert flow with a lazy Optional boundary.

checklist.name: Compiles and creates requested artifact
checklist.description: Creates a coherent WorkpadService.java with required imports, methods, records, and code that compiles for the task as written.

checklist.name: Implements required workpad behavior
checklist.description: Returns missing_action_id for existing workpad comments with null or blank id, comment_window_incomplete only when no workpad exists and the comment window has at least 1000 comments, and preserves updated:id:text and created:cardId:text status formats.

checklist.name: Preserves update/create branch timing
checklist.description: Updates only the existing workpad branch, creates only the absent-workpad branch, keeps create-side checks lazy, and does not run create or window checks when an existing workpad comment is present.

checklist.name: Uses Optional as update/create boundary
checklist.description: Uses a direct Optional boundary such as findFirst().map(...).orElseGet(...) or an equivalent value-binding shape for the update-or-create decision.

checklist.name: Avoids Optional antipatterns
checklist.description: Does not keep isPresent()/isEmpty() followed by get()/orElseThrow(), or replace the Optional with orElse(null), local null branching, Optional.stream().toList(), or a loop over one Optional.

checklist.name: Keeps lookup readable and single-purpose
checklist.description: Keeps the workpad lookup readable, avoids duplicate lookup work, and uses helper methods only where they clarify behavior.
